test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c85ddb2338bd9268c70f67fe42f9fa1b11ce95e0cecd355ca8f208b2f362f74.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes taking figure 1 and figure 2 ,the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 and 5 is common on both figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 2 is adjacent to the remaining number i.e., 4 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7033556c9e1c8b23afc722096e4a4e4e100239c858e3b141b0659c2a1b3ece2a.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1/3 → 5/6

2 → 4

So, the opposite side of "4" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "2".
